source.title: Retiring TNoodle 0.14.0
source.content:
When TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 [was released](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/tnoodle-0-15-0), we announced that TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 would briefly remain an officially permitted version. Since almost 2 weeks has passed, TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 is now officially retired, leaving TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 as the only official scramble program.

Please see last week's TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 announcement for details.

Please remember that official competitions must use a current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from:
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

translation.title: 停止使用 TNoodle 0.14.0
translation.content:
TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 [发布时](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/tnoodle-0-15-0)，我们曾宣布，TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 将在短期内继续作为正式允许使用的版本。现在已过去近 2 周，TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 正式停用，TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 成为唯一的官方打乱程序版本。

详情请参阅上周的 TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 公告。

请记住，正式比赛必须使用现行版本的官方打乱程序。下载地址始终为：
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
